title: Rep. Keith Self calls for ban on sharia law ahead of Texas proposition vote - Collin Times
text:
Rep. Keith Self, a U.S. Congressman from Texas, used his social media account on January 21, 2026, to promote the Sharia-Free America Caucus and advocate for legislation against the implementation of Sharia law in the United States.
In a post made at 19:59 UTC, Rep. Self highlighted an article by The Daily Signal about the caucus he co-founded with Rep. Chip Roy: ” BREAKING: An inside look by the @DailySignal at the Sharia-Free America Caucus, founded by @RepChipRoy and me.
Sharia poses a clear and imminent threat to our liberties. Now is the time for decisive action through legislation and education.”
Later that evening, at 20:26 UTC, Self urged Texans to vote in favor of Proposition 10 on March 3rd: “Rep. Self: ‘As Texas goes, so goes the nation.’
March 3rd is Texas’ turning point. Vote YES on Proposition 10 to BAN Sharia. Sharia has ZERO place in America—let alone in the Lone Star State.
Texans: Rise up. Defend the Constitution. Reject Sharia. Keep Texas free! “
In another statement posted at 20:56 UTC, Rep. Self discussed the origins of the caucus and expressed concern over what he described as a national issue: “.@RepChipRoy and I started the Sharia Free America Caucus to expose and stop the growing infiltration of Sharia in America.
This isn’t just happening in North Texas—members nationwide say it’s in their districts too.
Sharia is on the march. We must stop this radical takeover.”
Keith Self was elected to Congress after defeating Sandeep Srivastava in both 2022 and 2024 general elections with more than sixty percent of the vote each time.
